TOOLING BURST T0-d2 — O3b primitive-family motif detector, O9 declared-absent PART controls, F-5 gates, and the R9 lane extensions (SPEC § 6 row "T0-d lane extensions": items (c) (e) (f: F-5) and the THEN list; the T0-d2 half of conductor ruling R-3). task_id "T0-d2".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0 constraints, § 1 result schema, § 4 (O3, O9, bible schema v0.1, the acceptance list — your acceptance is VERBATIM from there), § 6 the "T0-d lane extensions" row: (c), (e), (f: F-5) and the THEN list.
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md
3. the existing astra_test_01/burst/{oracles,parts,compare,transcribe,bible,gates,lane,tests,fixtures}/ — amend in place; reuse gates/common.py result envelopes and oracles/common.py; do not rewrite what works. Read oracles/CALIBRATION.md and fixtures/manifest.json (the rod_head bbox).
4. Calibration inputs (read-only): astra_test_01/burst/fixtures/{f04_advanced_crop.png, clean_crop.png, sigil_template.png}; astra_test_01/run_03/character/frames/idle/S/*.png; and OUTSIDE the repo the X1 props /Users/admin/astra-burst/runs/C-1/X1-gen-01/out/x1_satchel.png and x1_staff_head.png (1254² RGB on a #00ff00 plate) plus their matted counterparts /Users/admin/astra-burst/runs/C-1/X1-chk-01/out/x1_satchel_rgba.png and x1_staff_head_rgba.png.
Do not read AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, role files, the charter, or anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy + scikit-learn ONLY; cv2/skimage/torch are ABSENT.

BUILD, in this priority order (deliver what completes inside the wall budget; name the remainder precisely in concerns — a T0-d3 burst continues):

(c) O3b — oracles/motif.py gains a PRIMITIVE-FAMILY mode beside template mode: `count_family(rgb, family='ring', min_radius_px, max_radius_px, vote_thresh, allowed_masks, display_scale=None)` → {inside, outside, peaks[] with center/radius/score}. Method: Loy–Zelinsky fast radial symmetry transform (gradient via scipy.ndimage.sobel; for each radius in the range, vote at the positively- and negatively-affected pixels along the gradient direction; orientation + magnitude projection images; Gaussian smoothing with sigma ∝ radius; combine across radii; peak NMS) or a gradient-vote circular Hough — numpy/scipy only. A size floor (min_radius_px) excludes buckles/rivets. Partition peaks by allowed masks exactly as template mode does. KEEP template mode for copy detection. The threshold `vote_thresh` is a named parameter whose calibration note cites a calibration set you build: synthetic rings at 3 known radii on a flat and on a textured background (every ring must be found, nothing else), a synthetic sprite with no rings (0), and the two real crops. ACCEPTANCE (SPEC § 4 verbatim, unchanged): F04 crop with allowed=[rod_head bbox] → outside ≥ 3; clean_crop → outside == 0. Do NOT tune the threshold to the F04 answer — the synthetic set justifies it; the real crops only confirm it; if the acceptance is not met, report the numbers. compare/compare_to_bible.py: the motif rule's `oracle` block gains `mode: template|family|both` (family names the primitive; the stub uses `both`, family `ring`); the rule is violated if EITHER count outside the allowed placements exceeds the declared count. tests/test_oracles_motif.py and tests/test_compare.py: the two currently-red cases must go green by this mechanism; add the synthetic-ring tests. Record the F04 / clean numbers in oracles/CALIBRATION.md.

(e) O9 PART-inventory question set + declared-absent PART controls + the X0-T calibration scorer. Today `transcribe/questions.py` inventories the MOTIF on each part only; the charter's X0-T calibrates a transcriber on the anatomical PART inventory (presence + count per closed part), so add a second, separate set. bible/schema.json (v0.1 → v0.2, additive, optional keys only): `controls: {declared_absent_parts: [str]}`; bible/f04-keepers.stub.json gains `controls.declared_absent_parts = ["helmet","cape","shield","second_belt"]` (anatomical PARTS, not sigils; invent no other vocabulary). transcribe/questions.py: keep `from_bible` (motif set) unchanged in behaviour; ADD `parts_from_bible(bible)` and a lower-level `parts_questions(parts: [str], controls: [str])` → one presence question + one dependent count question per closed part, PLUS the control parts appended to the closed list (marked `declared_absent_control: true`, expected absent / count 0), atomic, unique, dependency-ordered; ADD `parts_schema(parts, controls)` → the strict inventory schema over the closed list INCLUDING the control names (a transcriber must answer them). The lower-level form exists so a calibration list for a different figure (e.g. F03: coat, shirt, belt, pouch, strap, rivet_cluster, rifle …, controls helmet/cape/shield/staff) can be supplied WITHOUT inventing an F03 bible. compare/compare_to_bible.py: `compare_answers` must accept either set; any control answered present or count > 0 is a hard violation. NEW compare/calibrate_transcriber.py: `score(hand_inventory: {part: {present, count}}, answers: [inventory dicts from N bursts])` → per-burst and aggregate: presence precision / recall / F1 (controls included as negatives), fraction of parts whose count is within ±1 of the hand count, control catch-rate (fraction of control parts answered absent AND 0), and a per-part disagreement table; result envelopes with the charter's X0-T thresholds as NAMED parameters (presence P/R ≥ 0.9; counts ±1 on ≥ 80 % of parts; controls 100 %) — `passed` computed only when N ≥ 1. CLI: `--hand hand_inventory.json --answers a.json b.json … --out calibration.json`. Update tests/test_transcribe.py, test_compare.py, test_bible.py; add tests/test_calibrate_transcriber.py with a synthetic hand inventory + one perfect answer set (P=R=1, catch 1.0), one that claims a control present (catch < 1 → passed false), and one with counts off by 2 (±1 fraction drops).

(f: F-5) gates/plate_uniformity.py — `measure(rgb, subject_alpha=None, tol=8)` → result envelope with value = fraction of non-subject pixels within ±tol per channel of #00ff00, plus plate mean and sd per channel in `notes`; `min_fraction` is a named threshold parameter with a calibration note; calibration set = the two X1 props (the ledger recorded 100 % / 38 %, both sd < 1.1 — MEASURE and report your own numbers; if they differ, report, do not tune); `passed: null` when no threshold is declared. gates/matte.py — add an `alpha_floor` parameter (default None = behaviour unchanged): for character/prop mattes, residual alpha < alpha_floor (40/255 in the calibration) outside the subject's main connected component is set to 0; VFX/particle mode (preserve_particles) is unchanged when alpha_floor is None. Tests: on the two X1 props with alpha_floor=40 the g9_alpha border-clipping metric reads 0 (today 34 and 39); a synthetic particle field with preserve_particles and no floor keeps every particle; with the floor, an isolated 30/255 speck outside the main component is removed and a 200/255 particle is kept.

THEN the R9 extensions, in this order:
1. lane/provenance_capture.py — `capture(png_path) -> dict`: read PNG tEXt/iTXt/zTXt chunks and any XMP/C2PA manifest presence (issuer, model, generated_at, c2pa_present, raw keys) from a generated PNG AT INGEST, BEFORE matting; `write_sidecar(png_path, out_dir)` writes `<name>.provenance.json`. Hook: one call in lane/run_burst.py for GENERATE/LABEL bursts over the audit's `generated_images_new[]` (minimal diff; T0-d1 owns run_burst — re-run tests/test_run_burst.py after). Tests: a PNG with a planted iTXt chunk is read; a bare PNG yields nulls, never an exception.
2. lane/ref_provenance.py — `check(path) -> (ok: bool, reason: str)`: a task `references[]` path is first-party only if it resolves (no symlink escape) under astra_test_01/burst/runs/<run>/artifacts/, astra_test_01/run_0*/, astra_test_01/design/experiments/, or astra_test_01/burst/fixtures/; anything else refuses. One call in validate_task (minimal diff). Tests: allowed path OK; a path under /tmp refused; a symlink pointing outside refused.
3. oracles/pse_check.py — XAG-118 on a frame sequence (list of RGB arrays, fps, canvas w×h): general flash = a ≥10 % relative-luminance change (Rec.709 luma, normalised 0–1) between consecutive frames over ≥20 % of a 1280×720-equivalent area; count flashes per second over any 1-s window; fail when > 3; red-flash rule: saturated red where R/(R+G+B) ≥ 0.8 and a transition where (R−G−B)×320 > 20 over the same area rule; spatial-pattern rule: regular stripes/checks of ≥ 5 light–dark pairs covering ≥ 20 % of the area (report only, `passed: null` with reason if you cannot compute it robustly). Thresholds are named parameters with the XAG-118 citation in the docstring. Tests: a synthetic 4 Hz full-frame white/black flash fails; a 1 Hz flash passes; a saturated-red 4 Hz flash fails the red rule.
4. gates/matte_quality.py — on a matted RGBA + its green-plate source: spill fraction (subject pixels with green excess > tol), edge halo (mean green excess in a 2-px band just outside alpha ≥ 128), particle loss (alpha mass < 128 in the source's green-excess map that the matte removed); result envelopes; docstring marks the metric MODEL-COUPLED (re-validated on every drift alarm); calibration set = the two X1 props (report numbers).
5. oracles/sheet_consistency.py — for a frame set, a per-frame identity vector (O1 CIELAB palette histogram + O5 silhouette descriptor + alpha area, each normalised) → sheet dispersion: mean and max distance to the sheet centroid, and the farthest frame's index; result envelope with `passed: null` until a threshold is calibrated. Test: run_03 idle S frames (low dispersion) vs the same set with one frame mirrored (dispersion rises; the mirrored frame is the max).
6. oracles/model_drift_probe.py — the harness only (the probe PROMPTS are authored by the conductor at the HITL milestone — do not invent them): `probe_set.schema.json` (N entries: prompt, reference paths + sha256, expected canvas), `freeze(probe_set_path) -> sha256` (to be stored in the bible as `probe_set_sha256`), `distance(probe_outputs_dir, approved_dir)` → per-probe O5 / O1 / O8 distances + aggregate; alarm threshold a named parameter, `passed: null` until calibrated on the K1 run (say so in notes). Tests on synthetic pairs (identical → 0; mirrored/palette-shifted → larger).
7. Extensions to data contracts — bible/schema.json v0.2 (additive, optional): `never_generated[]`, per-asset `content_flags {blood, skeletal, religious_iconography}`, `asset_id` (slot-stable) distinct from `content_hash`, `probe_set_sha256`; stub updated with EMPTY/placeholder values only. receipt.schema.json is UNCHANGED (strict form: every property required; a burst cannot know a probe distance or a retirement date) — instead lane/ledger.py accepts, and run_burst.py writes into the LEDGER ENTRY, `generator: {observed_fingerprint: null, probe_set_sha256: null}` and `regeneratable_until: null` (conductor fills them after the probe runs). lane/deps_ledger.py keyed on asset_id: `record(run, asset_id, content_hash, deps[], state)`, `invalidate(run, asset_id) -> transitive set`, states include `generated | approved | human_edited → do_not_regenerate | invalidated`; atomic JSON at runs/<run>/deps.json (create only under tests/tmp during tests, never under runs/ now). Tests.

FINALLY run the FULL suite: `cd astra_test_01/burst && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B tests/run_t0c.py` (it rewrites tests/t0c_summary.json + t0c_suite_output.txt). Expected: ALL green — the two T0-c named-red cases are now green via O3b; the gates regression lock stays 0 differences. Report the exact counts.

DO NOT touch: lane/audit.py, lane/check_sync.py, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, receipt.schema.json, MANIFEST.sha256, runs/ (conductor-owned), briefs/. lane/run_burst.py and lane/ledger.py only by the minimal calls/fields named above. Do not run git. Temporary files ONLY under astra_test_01/burst/tests/tmp/ (create; clean). Never the system temp dir.

RETURN: the receipt (task_id "T0-d2"): "files" = every created/modified file with its sha256 (absolute paths under astra_test_01/burst are correct; the wrapper verifies them in place); "images": []; calls_used 0; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns must name precisely every acceptance case not met, with its number, and every THEN item not delivered. Never PASS/FAIL.
